character.name: Neil (N.E.I.L.)
character.identity: friendly, curious, intelligent little Mars assistant robot; warm, playful, encouraging; consistent single identity

lines.text: Brrr, the base is dark and cold, Rivo! We have 10 days to get ready.
How many solar panels should we put up?
Mars dust is like dirt on a phone screen. It steals our electricity!
Mars dust is like dirt on a phone screen. It steals our electricity!
Bigger grids make more power. But they use more of your 10 days!
Every day you spend on panels is a day you can't spend on something else. You have 10 in total.
lines.context: MISSION 1 Ask Earth reply relayed by Neil

lines.text: The Robot unpacks one small panel. The base lights flicker on.
lines.context: MISSION 1 card result caption (FAST MINI GRID)

lines.text: The Robot unpacks two panels. The base lights switch on.
Three panels click into place. The whole base lights up!
Four giant panels unfold. The base glows bright!
lines.context: MISSION 1 card result caption (MEGA SUN GRID)

lines.text: Power is on! But Mars is bone-dry, and our tank will run out on Sol 25.
How do we get more water, Rivo?
Smart! Astronauts on the Space Station reuse every drop too.
Careful, Rivo. This water will not last long enough for plants.
Water drips away every day. A recycler can reuse most of it!
A recycler leaves about 7 to 8 water bars at Sol 30. The dirt oven leaves only 2.
lines.context: MISSION 2 Ask Earth reply relayed by Neil

lines.text: The valve opens. The water bar flashes yellow.
lines.context: MISSION 2 card result caption (LANDER TANK ONLY)

lines.text: The Robot pours red dirt into the oven. Steam turns into slow drops.
lines.context: MISSION 2 card result caption (MARS DIRT OVEN)

lines.text: Clean blue water glows through looping pipes. The water bar steadies.
lines.context: MISSION 2 card result caption (SPACE WATER RECYCLER)

lines.text: Both machines roar! The battery drops sharply by 4 bars.
lines.context: MISSION 2 card result caption (SUPER WATER PLANT)

lines.text: Mars nights are -60°C, and the air outside is poison gas, Rivo!
Our air-maker (MOXIE) needs to get super hot first, so let's turn on the heater!
Great engineering, Commander! No heat means no air!
Great engineering, Commander! No heat means no air!
More heat makes more air. But it eats more power every day!
Cozy Warm needs at least 5 spare power bars to run safely.
lines.context: MISSION 3 Ask Earth reply relayed by Neil

lines.text: The heater sputters with a weak blue spark. MOXIE runs slowly.
lines.context: MISSION 3 card result caption (ECO PULSE MODE)

lines.text: Orange coils glow and fans bubble fresh air. The thermometer turns green!
lines.context: MISSION 3 card result caption (COZY WARM + AIR)

lines.text: The air-maker core glows red and pumps fast, but frost stays in the corners.
lines.context: MISSION 3 card result caption (TURBO OXYGEN CORE)

lines.text: Everything roars! The battery drops 8 bars.
lines.context: MISSION 3 card result caption (MAX HEAT & MAX AIR)

lines.text: Mars has no thick air to block invisible space rays, Rivo!
NASA found that water blocks them twice as well as dirt. How will we protect your bedroom?
Awesome! Water is full of tiny atoms that break up space rays.
Hmm, Rivo. The space rays will keep coming every day.
Water stops space rays best. Dirt is good too, and needs no power!
A water wall adds 4 shield bars. A dirt roof adds 2.
lines.context: MISSION 4 Ask Earth reply relayed by Neil

lines.text: Nothing changes. The shield icon stays yellow.
The Robot piles red dirt on the roof.
lines.context: MISSION 4 card result caption (MARS DIRT ROOF)

lines.text: The walls fill with blue water tanks around the Sleep Pod and Door.
lines.context: MISSION 4 card result caption (WATER WALL SHIELD)

lines.text: Water fills the walls indoors and a giant dirt hill grows outdoors.
Almost done, Rivo! Plants give us food and fresh air, and workouts keep our muscles strong.
What will you plant? And do you have time for the gym?
Spot on! Plants give us food and clean the air, too.
No crops this time, Rivo. Your body will need extra care later.
Crops give hearts and air. The gym keeps you strong for the Rover trip!
The Greenhouse needs at least 3 water bars projected at Sol 30.
lines.context: MISSION 5 Ask Earth reply relayed by Neil

lines.text: Purple LEDs shine over lush lettuce beds.
Potato plants grow under purple LEDs.
Red tomato vines climb under purple LEDs.
A full soybean farm grows, and the Gym switches on.
lines.context: MISSION 5 card result caption (MEGA SOYBEANS + GYM)

lines.text: Dust storm, Rivo! Dust is blocking the Sun, just like it did to NASA's Opportunity rover!
Should we power down, or send the Robot to clean the panels?
You beat the storm! We had a robot and smart power. Opportunity didn't!
Oh no, the battery ran dry like Opportunity! The Safe-Mode Capsule kept you safe!
A small grid should save power. A big grid can keep everything on!
A Medium or Giant grid can handle the Full Power Blast. A small grid cannot.
lines.context: CRISIS 1 Ask Earth reply relayed by Neil

lines.text: Lights dim to calm blue. The purple Greenhouse LEDs pause.
The Robot leaves the Airlock and brushes the panels until they gleam.
lines.context: CRISIS 1 card result caption (ROBOT PANEL SWEEP)

lines.text: Every light stays bright while the battery slowly drops.
lines.context: CRISIS 1 card result caption (FULL POWER BLAST)

lines.text: It's -85°C outside, Rivo! Our pipes and air-maker are starting to freeze!
Wrap the pipes and choose what gets the power first!
Real science: it really gets down to -85°C here! Frozen pipes can burst!
Real science: it really gets down to -85°C here! Frozen pipes can burst!
If your air is low, protect the air. If your air is high, protect the pipes!
The Backup Thermal Loop only opens if you chose Cozy Warm in Mission 3.
lines.context: CRISIS 2 Ask Earth reply relayed by Neil

lines.text: Orange coils glow on the pipes. The frost melts and water flows.
lines.context: CRISIS 2 card result caption (MAX PIPE HEAT)

lines.text: Rivo wears a thick parka. The Greenhouse goes into warm-up mode.
The backup loop hums. Orange coils glow and the water flows.
lines.context: CRISIS 2 card result caption (BACKUP THERMAL LOOP)

lines.text: Emergency, Rivo! A solar flare is coming. Seal the hatch and pump the water shield!
Pick a card and pull the lever before the sun ring runs out!
Real science: Mars has no thick air or magnet like Earth. Water walls and thick dirt are the best shields!
Real science: Mars has no thick air or magnet like Earth. Water walls and thick dirt are the best shields!
Hurry! The strong Crew Quarters is the safest place to hide.
With a Water Shield, sealing the hatch means zero radiation loss.
lines.context: CRISIS 3 Ask Earth reply relayed by Neil

lines.text: Rivo steps into the strong Crew Quarters. The steel hatch locks and water glows in the walls.
lines.context: CRISIS 3 card result caption (SEAL HATCH & PUMP WATER SHIELD)

lines.text: Shutters slide over the Greenhouse beds while Rivo watches from the corridor.
lines.context: CRISIS 3 card result caption (SHIELD THE GREENHOUSE)

lines.text: Screens flash red with a space-ray warning.
lines.context: CRISIS 3 card result caption (STAY IN THE GLASS DOME)

lines.text: RADIO BLACKOUT! The breakers tripped!
Open Rivo's Logbook to see how many Amps each machine uses, then fix the Power Room wires (maximum 10 Amps)!
We're back! You fixed it all by yourself with your Logbook, Commander!
We're back! Next time, check the Logbook amps before you connect.
23 Sols in Mars' light gravity make your body tired, Rivo!
Take care of your body now, so you're strong for the Rover trip!
Real science: in low gravity, astronauts lose muscle every month, so they work out daily!
Real science: in low gravity, astronauts lose muscle every month, so they work out daily!
A strong body makes the Rover trip easy. A tired body costs power and air!
The Fresh Air Valves only work if you planted a crop.
lines.context: CRISIS 5 Ask Earth reply relayed by Neil

lines.text: Rivo trains in warm-blue light, eats a fresh meal, and zips around again.
lines.context: CRISIS 5 card result caption (GYM & SLEEPY LIGHT)

lines.text: Rivo checks the happy crops and opens the valves. Green air floats through the base.
lines.context: CRISIS 5 card result caption (GREENHOUSE AIR VALVES)

lines.text: Rivo naps while the heart bar stays low.
lines.context: CRISIS 5 card result caption (QUICK BUNK REST)

lines.text: Ares-2 lands in 3 days, Rivo! The Sun is calm right now.
Let's charge the Rover and carry our Landing Beacon to the safe landing spot!
Look at NASA's Mars Trek map, Rivo! Mountains eat lots of Rover power, but flat roads take longer and use more air.
Flat tiles cost 1 point. Mountains cost 5, so go around them!
Today's Sun is calm (C3.4). A morning launch gives you a little extra shield.
lines.context: PHASE 3 Ask Earth reply relayed by Neil

lines.text: The lights stayed bright, but the small grid could not keep up and the battery ran dry.
lines.context: Crisis 1 Full Power Blast drains battery

lines.text: The hatch locks, but without a water shield some rays get through.
The sun ring ran out!
No gym machine, so Rivo does a body-weight workout instead.
Welcome to Alpha Base, Rivo! Walk to the Command Dome with the yellow arrow and press USE.
Next mission! Walk to the Command Dome and press the USE button.
First the heater! The air-maker only works when it is super hot.
Ice is on 3 pipe joints! Wrap them with heating coils first.
Hold the charge button until the Rover bar turns green. Then we check your fitness!
Fitness check: peak fitness! You carried the Beacon with no strain, so you have all 10 Move Points.
Fitness check: Rivo is tired and struggled with the Beacon. That cost 1 power and 1 air, and you start with 9 Move Points.
Rivo puts on the spacesuit helmet. When should we drive out?
Mountains eat lots of Rover power, but flat roads take longer and use more air. Choose your path wisely!
You made it to the green Landing Zone! Plant the Beacon and press the big red button!
The Robot towed the Rover to the Landing Zone. Plant the Beacon and press the big red button!
Green radio waves pulse from Mars to Earth...
ZAP! More than 10 Amps. The breaker blew, and the wires reset to basic life support.
Air-Maker, Heater, and Shield Pump: 9 Amps exactly. The fuse LEDs glow green and the lights come back!
Air-Maker and Heater: 7 Amps. Very safe, but the unpowered shield pump loses 1 shield bar.
The breaker holds, but an important machine had no power. Life support struggled.
Fireworks! All four meters are green and you never needed the capsule. You earned the Mars Hero Medal, and the base is 100% ready for the Ares-2 crew!
Ares-2 lands safely, and the crew helps top up what was low. Great teamwork!
The base protected Rivo in the Escape Pod until Ares-2 arrived. Rivo is safe!
Nothing bad happened to you, Rivo. The capsule did its job. Every commander learns from a rough Sol!
Every mission used real saved NASA and CSA records. You are a true Mars Commander!
Don't worry, Rivo! The capsule is keeping you safe while the base restarts.
The base is protecting you in the Escape Pod, Rivo. You are safe!
The water tank is empty! Rivo is thirsty.
No water machine: Rivo is getting thirsty.
The sky is turning brown... the panels are losing the Sun!
The Sun is coming back! The panels can breathe.
Brr! Frost is creeping over the pipes, Rivo!
Warm coils, flowing pipes. Nice and toasty again!
Any second now, Rivo! Pick a card and pull the lever!
Power is back! And you fixed it all by yourself, Commander.
Your muscles are getting sleepy in the low gravity, Rivo.
Now THAT is a spring in your step!
Beautifully done, Rivo!
That's a clever move!
Ooh, the colony likes that!
Look at us go!
You made that look easy!
Systems are smiling today!
That's one way to do it, Rivo.
Hmm! Let's keep an eye on the meters.
We can make that work!
Bold choice! We'll adapt as we go.
That's okay! Every commander learns.
Oops! Let's fix it together.
Mistakes are how we learn, Rivo.
Not the best pick. We'll know next time!
Yes! We did it!
Hooray for Team Rivo!
This is a great day for Mars!
Superb, Commander!
A brand new sticker for the album!
Ooh, shiny! That one is earned.
What a cool sticker!
The collection is growing!
Sticker secured!
We just unlocked something new!
Look what you opened up, Rivo!
New gear! That might help later.
Whoa!
Oh!
Wow!
Phew!
Safe at last!
That was close!
Let's try again!
You've got this, Rivo!
One step at a time!
Let's see...
Hmm, interesting...
Welcome back to the colony!
Home sweet Mars home!
The base missed you, Rivo!
Wheels up! Off we roll.
Full ahead, Rover!
Careful with the Move Points, Rivo!
Hmm, not many points left. Pick flat ground!
Sending the scout to peek ahead!
The scout found us a path!
Beacon planted! Now for the big red button!
Phew, thanks Robot!
Towed to safety! Smart save.
The battery is getting low, Rivo!
The lights are dimming...
The water tank is running low.
Let's be kind to the water drops!
The air bar is getting low, Rivo!
We need the air-maker happy!
The shield is getting thin, Rivo.
More space rays are sneaking through!
Your heart bar is low, Rivo.
You need a snack and a good rest!
Sleep tight, Commander.
Good morning, Mars!
Your 10 setup days are up! Mars storms start tomorrow, on Sol 11!
You survived the toughest 16 Sols! Only 4 days to go, and tomorrow we prep the Rover!
